via_allowance_budget: board (general (thickness 1.62)) in this file -- one through via traverses the full stackup, so its length-equivalent is taken as the board thickness itself (a straight top-to-bottom traversal), rounded up rather than down so the allowance is never optimistic about a via's real contribution. (0.02 mm different from nova_pcb_v6_logic's 1.6 mm -- these are two separately fabbed boards with their own stackup.)

groups.name: i2c_telemetry
groups.budget: INA226 rail telemetry, 400 kHz fast-mode I2C (Wire.setClock(400000), firmware/teensy/firmware/src/main.cpp:858). Bit period 2500 ns; 5% skew budget = 125 ns = 125000 ps / ~6.8 ps/mm ~= 18382 mm electrical bound -- I2C has no real matching requirement at this speed. tolerance_mm = 45 mm is a layout-discipline ceiling sized to THIS board's own routing (I2C_SDA runs 196 mm across the board to reach the INA226s vs I2C_SCL's 163 mm -- measured spread 36.6 mm on main, 2026-09-25, including via allowance) -- it exists only to catch a gross miroute (e.g. a daisy-chained rather than star-routed SDA leg), not to enforce margin I2C doesn't need.
